017public interface MissileAPI extends DamagingProjectileAPI {
018        boolean isFizzling();

020        
021        ShipEngineControllerAPI getEngineController();

023

030        
031        /**

035         */
036        MissileAIPlugin getMissileAI();
037        
038        
039        
040        /**
041         * Should only be used by a MissileAIPlugin.

043         */
044        void giveCommand(ShipCommand command);
045        
046        boolean isFlare();
047        
048        SpriteAPI getSpriteAPI();
049        
050        float getAcceleration();
051        float getMaxSpeed();
052        float getMaxTurnRate();
053        float getTurnAcceleration();
054        
055        float getMaxFlightTime();

057        
058        float getFlightTime();
059        void setFlightTime(float flightTime);
060        boolean isGuided();
061        boolean isArmed();
062        float getArmingTime();
063        void setArmingTime(float armingTime);
064        /**

067         * @param armedWhileFizzling
068         */
069        void setArmedWhileFizzling(boolean armedWhileFizzling);
070        boolean isArmedWhileFizzling();

072        /**
073         * Number of times a missile will ignore being hit by an system EMP *arc* (not emp damage) instead of flaming out.
074         * @param empResistance
075         */
076        void setEmpResistance(int empResistance);
077        int getEmpResistance();
078        void decrEMPResistance();

080        /**
081         * Useful for missiles that change position using a script. Call twice - once before the missile
082         * is moved, and once when it has moved to its new location.
083         */
084        void interruptContrail();
085        void fadeOutThenIn(float inDur);
086        float getTimeSinceFizzling();
087        void setTimeSinceFizzling(float timeSinceFizzling);
088        
089        /**
090         * Just data flags, WILL NOT actually make the missile a mine/adjust mine properties/etc.
091         * @return
092         */
093        boolean isMine();

095        /**
096         * Just data flags, WILL NOT actually make the missile a mine/adjust mine properties/etc.
097         * @return
098         */
099        void setMine(boolean isMine);
100        
101        /**
102         * Just data flags, WILL NOT actually make the missile a mine/adjust mine properties/etc.
103         * @return
104         */
105        void setMineExplosionRange(float mineExplosionRange);
106        
107        /**
108         * Just data flags, WILL NOT actually make the missile a mine/adjust mine properties/etc.
109         * @return
110         */
111        boolean isMinePrimed();

113        /**
114         * Just data flags, WILL NOT actually make the missile a mine/adjust mine properties/etc.
115         * @return
116         */
117        float getMineExplosionRange();

119        /**
120         * Just data flags, WILL NOT actually make the missile a mine/adjust mine properties/etc.
121         * @return
122         */
123        void setMinePrimed(boolean isMinePrimed);

125        /**
126         * Just data flags, WILL NOT actually make the missile a mine/adjust mine properties/etc.
127         * @return
128         */
129        float getUntilMineExplosion();

131        /**
132         * Just data flags, WILL NOT actually make the missile a mine/adjust mine properties/etc.
133         * @return
134         */
135        void setUntilMineExplosion(float untilMineExplosion);

137        void setJitter(Object source, Color color, float intensity, int copies, float minRange, float range);
138        float getCurrentBaseAlpha();

143        void setShineBrightness(float brightness);

145        boolean isMirv();

154        WeaponSpecAPI getWeaponSpec();
155        void setWeaponSpec(String weaponId);

157        
158        /**
159         * Returns the AI that was passed in to setMissileAI(). getMissileAI() returns an internal wrapper around that.
160         * @return
161         */
162        MissileAIPlugin getUnwrappedMissileAI();

164        
165        Object getParamAboutToApplyDamage();

185        void setMaxRange(float maxRange);
186        void setMaxFlightTime(float maxFlightTime);
187        float getSpriteAlphaOverride();
188        void setSpriteAlphaOverride(float spriteAlphaOverride);

213        List<EngineSlotAPI> getEngineLocationsCopy();

216        // always null anyway
